text.tspan: Fig. 3 (a) Unclustered distribution, (b) a 2-dimensional distribution of
BTV corresponding to carbon-rich fuel and green renewable fuel
results from the elbow locator method to find an
optimal number of clusters. In this method, different
numbers of clusters are tested, and the sum squared
error (SSE) is calculated. Our experiments show that
three is a suitable number of clusters.
Fig.4 Knee locator estimates the optimal number of clusters
for Bitcoin transactions to be three.
Accordingly, minibatch K-means is parameterized to
create three clusters, as shown in Fig.5.
Fig.5 Hourly Bitcoin transactions distributed across three clusters
The clusters show electricity consumption of Bitcoin
transformed and scaled BTV data results in many
suggestive clusters, as shown in Fig.6.
Fig.6. Distribution of Bitcoin transactions using Mean-shift
consumption is clustered into green-renewable and
carbon-rich fuel usage, as shown in Fig.7. Therefore,
the categorization is based on carbon-rich fuel usage
and further sub-categorization into green fuel usage
within a category of carbon-rich fuel usage.
